news.title: De la Fuente: I have a sixth sense, Yamal is a genius, and I am not thinking about the 2030 World Cup
news.lede: The Spain national team's door is open to Morata and Carvajal. Luis de la Fuente is the most talked-about manager on the planet right now, having steered Spain to World Cup glory at Argentina's expense. La Roja lifted the trophy for the second time in their history, edging Argentina 1-0 after extra time. Speaking to AS newspaper, De la Fuente laid bare the secrets behind a side that has now won Euro 2024 and the 2026 World Cup.

news.title: 'Don't retire yet': Di María makes desperate plea to Lionel Messi after Argentina's World Cup agony
news.lede: Ángel Di María has urged Lionel Messi not to retire from international football following Argentina's heartbreaking defeat to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final, insisting the captain should continue representing his country for "many more years" despite another painful ending on football's biggest stage. Football News: Ángel Di María has made a heartfelt plea to Lionel Messi, urging him not to retire from international football after Argentina's narrow loss to Spain in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final. Di María believes Messi can represent Argentina for many more years, highlighting his remarkable performances during the tournament even at age 39.

news.title: Gianni Infantino letter to Argentina 'leaked’ with astonishing claim on violent World Cup scenes
news.lede: Gianni Infantino wrote a swooning letter to the president of the Argentinian Football Association despite their violent reaction to losing the World Cup fina l. This letter has been leaked in Argentina, not long after FIFA opened an investigation into the violent fracas which followed Spain's 1-0 victory over the South Americans. The football world was left shocked as the likes of Leandro Parades, Nahuel Molina and even Argentinian assistant coach Roberto Ayala brawled with several Spanish players. FIFA issued a statement saying they were investigating "offensive behaviour and violations of the principles of fair play" in the Argentines.

news.title: Spanish football team | Masters of the midfield
news.lede: In 2010, Spain reached the pinnacle of international football with a squad overflowing with established stars. A generation of world-class players combined technical brilliance, tactical intelligence and an unwavering belief in the power of possession to secure the nation’s first FIFA World Cup title. The team that won its maiden World Cup title also lifted the European Championship before and after it. That squad set a benchmark for Spanish, nay, world football.

news.title: Official warning over the World Cup: what happened in Britain is unprecedented!
news.lede: World Cup sparks a serious crisis: violence and mass arrests. The repercussions of the 2026 World Cup were not confined to the pitch. Official figures in the United Kingdom revealed an unprecedented rise in domestic violence incidents and crimes linked to the tournament, with warnings over the role that alcohol consumption played in worsening the crisis. Domestic violence cases in the United Kingdom hit their highest levels ever during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

news.title: Football’s broken clock: What Messi and Ronaldo waited decades for, Lamine Yamal already has
news.lede: Because football can take a man carrying private grief and, for a few seconds, give him somewhere to put it. Take Liverpool star Cody Gakpo. He and his partner had suffered a personal loss during the World Cup and, days later, he scored against Morocco. He did not celebrate so much as collapse, falling to the ground in tears as his teammates gathered around him.

news.title: New York Giants Football Player Debunks Common Narrative About Frozen Grass Compared To Artificial Turf
news.lede: NFL players were sad to see their employers remove the natural grass playing surface from the World Cup in a return to artificial turf for the upcoming football season. New York Giants offensive lineman Jermaine Eluemunor wants to set the record straight. Unfortunately, NFL owners do not seem to care. They are only focused on what serves their bank accounts instead of what serves their players.
